clips.title: The story
paras: Shael'dryn is an inquisitive dryad residing beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale. Known for her lighthearted wit and fondness for wordplay, she serves as a vital contact for night elf scouts investigating forest corruption. She plays a pivotal role in aiding Astranaar's sentinels with cleansing relics to combat demonic and foul influences spreading across the wilderness.

Daughter of Cenarius like all dryads, Shael'dryn approaches the perils of the wild with an unexpectedly playful spirit. Companions and travelers know her as a lover of puns and spoken jests, often using lighthearted humor to cut through the brooding tension of the tainted woodland. Yet behind her teasing demeanor lies deep devotion to the well-being of Ashenvale and its ancient spirits.
